facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Location: Remote + Silicon Valley / New York network
facts_raw.Focus: Technical builders across AI, enterprise, defense, healthcare, biotech, clima...
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 可选择不拿投资参与；若拿 US$10K，官方称按 US$1B valuation cap 转换，在下一轮 priced round 转股。
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 技术型 builder；可 solo 或团队；不要求已成立公司；不要求退学/辞职。可从 side project、idea 或早期 startup 申请。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 非常早期但行动力强；能展示正在 build 的具体项目/产品；技术 founder 或强 builder 背景；能从顶级 founder mentor network 中快速吸收并执行。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 主要 virtual。最后一天在 San Francisco 或 New York 线下；多数 Fellow 会选择整周到 SF/NYC，但官网并未要求全程必须线下。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 不要求特定所在地。若选择参加 SF/NYC 线下部分，需自行具备合法入境资格；官网未公开 visa sponsorship。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: No deadline; multiple cohorts per year
facts_raw.Application Materials: 一份团队申请即可；说明项目/side project、创始人背景和你正在 build 的内容。无需已成立公司。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官网 Apply；公开 founder 短信：650-505-9984；一般问题可用官网公开邮箱。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；B2B / Enterprise SaaS；阶段以 Pre-idea–very early 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 评价：非常适合极早期 technical builder / student / side-project founder；不适合作为成熟公司系统性融资加速器。核心价值是 network 和 founder signal，不是 $10K。

facts.Location: Remote + Silicon Valley / New York network
facts.Focus: Technical builders across AI, enterprise, defense, healthcare, biotech, clima...
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: Investment is optional. The optional $10K converts at a $1B valuation cap in the next priced round, according to the official terms.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Technical solo founders or teams, from side projects to early startups. Incorporation and leaving work or study are not required.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Very early, proactive builders with concrete projects, strong technical backgrounds and the ability to learn quickly from founder mentors.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Primarily virtual, with the final day in SF or NYC. Many fellows attend the full week locally, but this is not required.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No required home location. Participants choosing SF or NYC activities need lawful entry; visa sponsorship is not published.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: No deadline; multiple cohorts per year
facts.Application Materials: One application per team covering the project or side project, founder backgrounds and current work. Incorporation is not required.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official application; published founder text number: 650-505-9984. General questions may use the official public email.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; B2B / Enterprise SaaS; primarily at the Pre-idea–very early stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Best for very early technical builders, students and side-project founders. The network and founder development matter more than the $10K; not a systematic fundraising accelerator for mature companies.

ranking.amountBasis: Published initial cash; excludes conditional follow-on and non-cash benefits
